policy.default_data: exclude every bundled pool/decree; fail closed on stale local config
policy.currency: Thematic consumable/material payouts primary; optional currency when appropriate; no independent exchange rate and no command rewards until safe shared-account semantics verified
policy.transformation: Gate creation/acquisition of the specialized decree; normal Bountiful acceptance and redemption thereafter. Disable random spawn/reveal/wander buy; recipe with form-exclusive crafting access or minimal authoritative-state check if needed; public board and transferable document are not claim-time restrictions.
policy.kills: Native Bountiful entity objective attribution only; eligible exact entity IDs, reviewed counts/pay per kill, no Hunter coupling
policy.prices: final effective runtime EMC evidence required; no vanilla defaults or independently invented conversion
policy.objectives: Native exact-item deliveries and native entity kill objectives; no custom magic-event predicates required

schools.name: Occultism
schools.reward_notes: Owner-approved complete five-item payout roster. No chalk, Iesnium, or other rewards. Afrit/Marid essences are intentional alternatives to native acquisition; balance quantities and contract difficulty, not eligibility of the selected items. No bound books, workers, miners, or completed ritual products. Exact registered IDs/counts and final economy review remain runtime staging gates.

held_schools.reason: Owner explicitly excluded from Bountiful decrees 2026-11-19; Theurgy mod itself remains installed.

balance_draft.notes: Tier floors are effort floors, not new ProjectE prices. Positive EMC value is still required. Reward-first, one reward and one filler preferred, native rarity weights and reputation. Lowest available reward tier never rep-gated, so boards cannot produce empty offers purely from reputation. Fixed quantity one-shot special reward output; premium-only decree uses difficult objectives rather than pretending rarity limits standalone board frequency.
